themes.name: Push notifications
themes.description: Push or breaking-news alerts from the app, including the inability to find or use a setting to turn them off, their frequency or content, and notifications that do not clear after being opened.

themes.name: Playlist and queue
themes.description: Saving stories or podcasts to the playlist/queue, including playlists being erased on close or update, difficulty finding, adding to, removing from or playing the playlist.

themes.name: Live stream buffering and connection
themes.description: Live station streaming that buffers, stalls, drops, fails to connect, or takes very long to load, including 'connecting' loops and 'unable to play this media' or 'no audio available' errors.

themes.name: Skipping and mid-story playback
themes.description: Audio that skips, jumps back or forward, repeats, starts stories partway through, or cuts off before the end of stories and programs.

themes.name: Crashes and freezes
themes.description: The app crashing, freezing, closing unexpectedly, or being generally buggy or unstable, including device-specific issues like lock-screen loops that lock up the phone.

themes.name: Battery and background activity
themes.description: Battery drain, data usage, memory use, and the app running, starting or playing on its own in the background, including inability to close or quit the app.

themes.name: Interface design
themes.description: The look, layout and navigation of the app, including dated or outdated UI, requests for material design, menus, and usability of the interface.

themes.name: Tablet and landscape support
themes.description: Screen rotation, landscape mode, and tablet-optimized layout, including the app being locked to portrait orientation.

themes.name: Local station finder
themes.description: Finding, selecting, saving and listening to local NPR stations, including the nearest-stations feature and stations disappearing from favorites or the station list.

themes.name: Chromecast and Android Auto
themes.description: Requests for or comments on casting to Chromecast or Google Cast and compatibility with Android Auto or car integration.

themes.name: Ads and sponsorship
themes.description: Banner ads that cannot be dismissed, ad placement over content, and sponsor or underwriting spots that play before or during audio.

themes.name: Offline downloads
themes.description: Ability to download podcasts, programs or articles for offline listening or reading.

themes.name: Article text and images
themes.description: Display of article content, including garbled or overlapping text, missing images, charts, maps and tweets, small font sizes, and stories failing to show in the app.

themes.name: Program and podcast catalog
themes.description: Availability of specific NPR shows and podcasts in the app, including missing shows, programs not updating, or the programs tab not working.

themes.name: Content freshness and updates
themes.description: Stories, hourly news or shows that are outdated or fail to refresh with new content, and how often content updates.

themes.name: Media controls
themes.description: Playback controls such as pause, play, seek, lock screen or notification-bar controls, widget, sleep timer and resuming position.

themes.name: Permissions and privacy
themes.description: The permissions the app requests, location or phone access, and data privacy concerns.

themes.name: Editorial bias and trust
themes.description: Perceptions of NPR's political slant, objectivity, trustworthiness and accuracy of its reporting.

themes.name: App updates and maintenance
themes.description: How the developer handles updates, releases and fixes, including recent updates that broke things, the app seeming neglected, and unresponsive support or feedback channels.
